description: Change fields of a Dynamics 365 account (logical names). Read first, If-Match on the etag, stored values checked afterwards. WRITES into the customer's Dynamics 365 — it goes through the permission gate and the Dynamics write log (audit_log dynamics_write).

account_id.description: ID of the account (company) to change

fields.description: further Dataverse columns by logical name (lower case, e.g. {"address1_city":"Leipzig"}); lookups as {"parentaccountid@odata.bind":"/accounts(<GUID>)"}

name: update_dynamics_account
